formulas.name: formulaAGSTier
formulas.expression:
IF( AND( ISBLANK({!varAGS}), ISBLANK({!varAGSTier})), {!ConT2},
IF( OR( AND( ISBLANK({!varAGSTier}), {!varAGS}>=0, {!varAGS}<{!varT1InternetMailerLimit}),
AND( ISBLANK({!varAGS}), {!varAGSTier}={!conTier1}),
AND( {!varAGSTier}={!conTier1}, {!varAGS}>=0, {!varAGS}<{!varT1InternetMailerLimit})),
{!conT1},
IF( OR( AND( ISBLANK({!varAGSTier}), {!varAGS}>={!varT1InternetMailerLimit}, {!varAGS}<{!varT2InternetMailerLimit}),
AND( ISBLANK({!varAGS}), {!varAGSTier}={!conTier2}),
AND( {!varAGSTier}={!conTier1}, {!varAGS}>={!varT1InternetMailerLimit}, {!varAGS}<{!varT2InternetMailerLimit}),
AND( {!varAGSTier}={!conTier2}, {!varAGS}<{!varT1InternetMailerLimit}),
AND( {!varAGSTier}={!conTier2}, {!varAGS}>={!varT1InternetMailerLimit}, {!varAGS}<{!varT2InternetMailerLimit})),
{!ConT2},
IF( OR( AND( ISBLANK({!varAGSTier}), {!varAGS}>={!varT2InternetMailerLimit}), AND( ISBLANK({!varAGS}), {!varAGSTier}={!conTier3}), AND( {!varAGSTier}={!conTier1}, {!varAGS}>={!varT2InternetMailerLimit}), AND( {!varAGSTier}={!conTier2}, {!varAGS}>={!varT2InternetMailerLimit}), AND( {!varAGSTier}={!conTier3}, {!varAGS}>=0, {!varAGS}<{!varT1InternetMailerLimit}), AND( {!varAGSTier}={!conTier3}, {!varAGS}>={!varT1InternetMailerLimit}, {!varAGS}<{!varT2InternetMailerLimit}), AND( {!varAGSTier}={!conTier3}, {!varAGS}>={!varT2InternetMailerLimit})), {!ConT3},
{!ConFault}
))))

formulas.name: formulaRoundRobinFlow
formulas.expression:
IF( AND( {!inputDLPUnassigned}=TRUE, {!formulaAGSTier}={!ConT2}), {!conDLPUnassignedT2},
IF( AND( {!inputDLPUnassigned}=TRUE, {!formulaAGSTier}={!ConT3}), {!conDLPUnassignedT3},
IF( AND( {!inputDLPUnassigned}=TRUE, {!formulaAGSTier}={!conT1}), {!conDLPUnassignedT1},
IF( {!formulaAGSTier}={!ConT2}, {!conT2InternetMailer},
IF( {!formulaAGSTier}={!ConT3}, {!conT3InternetMailer},
IF( {!formulaAGSTier}={!conT1}, {!conT1InternetMailer},
{!conT3InternetMailer} ))))))
